title: FrameworkSchema
description: 🧬️ The `framework.schema` scope: the `(scope id, export id, format id)` resolution contract every scope and every catalog tool speaks, plus the entity-kind catalog the `schema-entity-catalog` generator projects into TypeScript, Rust and Go. The root is a `oneOf` of the two instance documents this scope serializes to disk — the `schema-export-registry-entries-v1` dump (an object) and `🏷️entity-kinds/🔣️.json` (an array) — which are disjoint by JSON type, so exactly one branch can ever match.

SchemaFormat.title: SchemaFormat
SchemaFormat.description: 🗂️ One of the five schema formats a scope publishes, spelled with the ascii id the derived catalog and the `schema://` resolver use. `SCHEMA_FORMAT_TAXONOMY_KEYS` maps each to its taxonomy `schemaFormats` emoji key.

FacetLeaves.title: FacetLeaves
FacetLeaves.description: 🍃 The five handcrafted leaf bodies one facet or one named export is carried by. An empty body means the scope does not provide that format and resolution answers `format-absent`.

SchemaExport.title: SchemaExport
SchemaExport.description: 🏷️ One named export of a scope — the `(export id, five format leaves)` pair the resolution key needs beyond the four fixed facets of an artifact schema descriptor.

id.description: PascalCase key of the module's `$defs`; never one of the reserved facet ids `artifact`/`snapshot`/`diff`/`mutations`.

ScopeSchemaExports.title: ScopeSchemaExports
ScopeSchemaExports.description: 🧬️ A scope's named exports, declared as a SIBLING to the four fixed facets of an artifact schema descriptor rather than as a field on it.

scope.description: Dotted scope id derived from the module `$id` path after `https://semio.tech/schema/`, e.g. `framework.schema`, `hub.inference`, `s.writer.writer`.

SchemaExportEntry.title: SchemaExportEntry
SchemaExportEntry.description: 📇️ One resolvable `(scope id, export id, format id)` triple. A triple exists only when the leaf for that format is non-empty.

scope.description: Dotted scope id derived from the module `$id` path after `https://semio.tech/schema/`, e.g. `framework.schema`, `hub.inference`, `s.writer.writer`.

export.description: A resolvable export id: a PascalCase `$defs` key or one of the four reserved facet ids of an artifact schema descriptor.

SchemaExportEntries.title: SchemaExportEntries
SchemaExportEntries.description: 📤️ The `schema-export-registry-entries-v1` dump of the runtime export registry, read by `schema verify --rust-entries`. Entries are sorted and deduplicated by `(scope, export, format)`.

contractId.description: Taxonomy `schemaExportResolution.rustEntriesContractId`; any other value is refused by the consumer.

generator.description: The exact command that produced this dump.

SchemaResolveError.description: ⚠️ Why a `(scope id, export id, format id)` triple did not resolve. Resolution is exact: no nearest-parent search, no glob, no fixture-local fallback.

ValidationDiagnostic.title: ValidationDiagnostic
ValidationDiagnostic.description: 🩺 One structural validation failure as the owned draft-07 validator renders it: the instance path the failure is attributed to and the reason, joined by `": "` in the emitted message.

instancePath.description: Instance location in the validator's own rendering: `$`, `$.name`, `$.items[0]`.

reason.description: Why the instance was rejected, without the path prefix.

EntityKindCatalog.title: EntityKindCatalog
EntityKindCatalog.description: 📚️ The ordered entity-kind catalog, the single source `🏷️entity-kinds/🔣️.json` carries and the `schema-entity-catalog` generator projects into `🤖️generated/🏷️entity-kinds/🟦️.ts`, `🤖️generated/🏷️entity-kinds/🦀️.rs` and `⌨️cli/🏷️entity-kinds/🐹️.go`. Declaration order is contract twice over: `id` is unique catalog-wide, `emoji` is NOT, and every projection's emoji index keeps the FIRST entry of a repeated emoji (`technology-mono` wins 🌱️ over `interaction-started`, `draft` wins 📝️ over `todo`). `uniqueItems` only forbids two byte-identical entries; uniqueness of `id` and of `label` alone is not expressible in draft-07 and is asserted against the data by the owning tests instead.

EntityKind.title: EntityKind
EntityKind.description: 🏷️ One entity kind: the identifier every consumer switches on, the emoji that prefixes its ids in source and ticket text, the icon a tree item renders, the label a filter view shows, and whether the filter view offers it at all.

id.description: 🔑️ Kebab-case entity kind id, unique across the catalog. Multi-part ids are `<family>-<variant>` and consumers read the family prefix (the VS Code extension's `isDefinitionEntityId` tests `definition-`; its filter commands are registered per family).

emoji.description: 😀️ VS16-normalized emoji prefix of the kind's ids. NOT unique: two kinds may share one emoji, and every projection's emoji index then resolves it to the first declared kind.

iconId.description: 🖼️ Kebab-case icon id a tree item renders. Not unique: `pen-tool` and `check-circle-2` each serve two kinds.

label.description: 🔤️ Human-readable name shown in filter and monorepo views, unique across the catalog and free of leading or trailing whitespace.

filterable.description: 🔎️ Whether a filter view offers this kind as a toggle. The six aggregate kinds (`codebase`, `technologies`, `bundles`, `folders`, `files`, `definitions`) are tree roots and are not filterable.
